# SIGNIN-1 — Shoppers stay signed in

## Problem

Shoppers are signed out every hour.

## Scope / Non-goals

- A session lasts a week.

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC1: a shopper stays signed in for a week.

## Task Decomposition

- SIGNIN-1-T1: longer sessions.

## Risks

- A stolen session lasts longer.
